en_title: Ben Affleck's Batman Movie Would Have Featured Arkham Asylum-Inspired Deathstroke Fight and DCEU Batgirl, Joe Manganiello Reveals
cn_title: 演员揭秘阿弗莱克版《蝙蝠侠》剧情
subtitle: 丧钟的复仇
opus_summary: 丧钟演员在回忆录中披露，阿弗莱克已取消的《蝙蝠侠》电影原计划让蝙蝠女参战，戈登则会遇害。丧钟因误信蝙蝠侠杀了儿子而复仇，最终决战拟借鉴阿卡姆游戏影像。

paragraphs.en: Joe Manganiello has revealed new plot details about Ben Affleck's canceled Batman movie, including information about an Arkham Asylum-inspired fight with Deathstroke and the DCEU's Batgirl.
paragraphs.cn: Joe Manganiello披露了本·阿弗莱克那部已取消的《蝙蝠侠》电影的更多剧情细节，包括一场借鉴《蝙蝠侠：阿卡姆疯人院》的丧钟对决，以及DC扩展宇宙（DCEU）中的蝙蝠女。

paragraphs.en: The actor, who was cast as Slade Wilson before the comic book movie universe was rebooted with the DCU, talked about his time working with Affleck on the canned project in his new book, Bloodlines: A Memoir. Entertainment Weekly shared excerpts from the book, which said the Batman movie would have been packed with reveals – and even a death – for some of Bruce Wayne's closest allies.
paragraphs.cn: 在这个漫改电影宇宙重启为DC宇宙（DCU）之前，Manganiello曾获选饰演斯莱德·威尔逊。他在新书《Bloodlines: A Memoir》中，回顾了与阿弗莱克合作筹备这部后来被取消的电影的经历。Entertainment Weekly分享了书中节选，其中提到，这部《蝙蝠侠》电影原本会揭开布鲁斯·韦恩几位亲密盟友的诸多秘密，甚至安排其中一人死亡。

paragraphs.en: Affleck's plan for his standalone Caped Crusader flick would have seen Batman primarily tangling with Deathstroke after the character was first teased in a Justice League end-credits sequence . He described the narrative as "a superhero version of David Fincher's The Game" focused on Deathstroke trying to "dismantle Batman's entire life."
paragraphs.cn: 按照阿弗莱克对这部蝙蝠侠独立电影的构想，蝙蝠侠的主要对手会是丧钟。丧钟此前已在《正义联盟》的片尾彩蛋中首次亮相。阿弗莱克将这个故事形容为「超级英雄版的大卫·芬奇电影《心理游戏》」，围绕丧钟试图「彻底摧毁蝙蝠侠的生活」展开。

paragraphs.en: This is a plot description Manganiello has shared before , but now we know that the iconic DC villain had it out for Batman because he had been led to believe that he murdered his son. Affleck's Bruce Wayne has been known to take lives in the past, but how involved he would have been with the killing of Slade's son is unclear. It sounds like that wouldn't have stopped Deathstroke from tearing Gotham apart to get revenge.
paragraphs.cn: Manganiello此前分享过这个剧情梗概，但如今我们才知道，这位标志性的DC反派之所以盯上蝙蝠侠，是因为有人让他相信，蝙蝠侠杀害了他的儿子。阿弗莱克饰演的布鲁斯·韦恩过去确实杀过人，但他究竟在多大程度上牵涉斯莱德儿子的死，目前尚不清楚。不过听起来，这并不会阻止丧钟为了复仇而大闹哥谭。

paragraphs.en: Slade's rampage would have also seen him breaking his way into Bruce's ever-secretive Batcave and even taking his butler, Alfred Pennyworth, hostage. This Alfred likely would have been the one played by Jeremy Irons in movies like Batman v. Superman: Dawn of Justice and Justice League . Another part that would have probably returned in Affleck's canceled movie is J.K. Simmons' Jim Gordon. According to Manganiello, Deathstroke would have killed the Gotham City Police commissioner at some point during the events of the film.
paragraphs.cn: 斯莱德还会一路杀进布鲁斯一向严密保密的蝙蝠洞，甚至将他的管家阿尔弗雷德·潘尼沃斯扣为人质。这位阿尔弗雷德很可能仍由杰瑞米·艾恩斯饰演，他曾在《蝙蝠侠大战超人：正义黎明》和《正义联盟》等电影中出演这一角色。J·K·西蒙斯饰演的吉姆·戈登也可能在阿弗莱克这部已取消的电影中回归。据Manganiello透露，丧钟会在电影中的某个时刻杀死这位哥谭市警察局长。

paragraphs.en: Affleck was never able to put his Batman movie together, but these details suggest the project was planned, at least at one point, to be pretty busy for a standalone superhero outing. Adding to the chaos would have been a new Batgirl, who would have joined Batman for a fight against Deathstroke that would nearly kill them both before they "escape via an aboveground train."
paragraphs.cn: 阿弗莱克最终没能拍成自己的《蝙蝠侠》电影，但这些细节表明，至少在某个阶段的构想中，这部超级英雄独立电影的内容相当密集。一位全新的蝙蝠女也会加入这场混战，与蝙蝠侠联手迎战丧钟。两人几乎丧命，随后才「搭乘地面列车逃脱」。

paragraphs.en: Comic book movie watchers will remember that Batgirl never made an appearance in the DCEU – at least not officially. An also-canceled standalone movie focused on the character was once in development with Leslie Grace in the titular role before Warner Bros. made the infamous decision to pull the plug well into production.
paragraphs.cn: 熟悉漫改电影的观众应该记得，蝙蝠女从未在DCEU中登场，至少没有正式登场。这个角色也曾有一部由Leslie Grace主演的独立电影进入制作，但同样遭到取消。华纳兄弟在制作已推进许久后决定叫停，成为了一桩备受诟病的事件。

paragraphs.en: Set photos and early details for that film had Michael Keaton's Bruce Wayne back in the Batsuit and Simmons back as Gordon, so it's hard to say exactly how it would have fit into the DCEU should it have been released. Whether Grace would have played the character in Affleck's Batman movie is also unclear.
paragraphs.cn: 那部电影的片场照和早期信息显示，迈克尔·基顿饰演的布鲁斯·韦恩会再度穿上蝙蝠战衣，西蒙斯也会回归饰演戈登。因此，即便电影当时顺利上映，也很难说它具体会如何融入DCEU。阿弗莱克的《蝙蝠侠》电影是否也会由Grace出演蝙蝠女，同样不得而知。

paragraphs.en: For the Affleck movie, Manganiello went as far as to explain the movie's final fight sequence, which he described as a "climactic one-on-one showdown through the streets of Gotham. Affleck apparently told the actor that this particular fight sequence would have been inspired by what Entertainment Weekly described as a "CGI fight sequence from the Batman: Arkham Asylum video game helmed by Tim Miller."
paragraphs.cn: 谈到阿弗莱克的电影时，Manganiello甚至详细介绍了最终战斗，将其形容为「一场贯穿哥谭街头的高潮一对一决战」。据称，阿弗莱克曾告诉他，这场战斗会借鉴一段影像。Entertainment Weekly将其描述为「由蒂姆·米勒执导、出自游戏《蝙蝠侠：阿卡姆疯人院》的CG打斗片段」。

paragraphs.en: The fight scene referenced here might be a well-known moment from the first trailer for Batman: Arkham Origins , which featured a lengthy scrap between Deathstroke and Batman in a snowy shipyard. Considering Affleck's movie was canceled and reworked into what eventually became Robert Pattinson and Matt Reeves' The Batman in 2022, we may never know what the film would have looked like, but Manganiello recalls being hopeful at the time.
paragraphs.cn: 这里提到的打斗场面，可能其实是《蝙蝠侠：阿卡姆起源》首支预告片中的知名片段：丧钟与蝙蝠侠在一座白雪覆盖的造船厂里展开了一场长时间的交锋。阿弗莱克的电影被取消后，项目经过重新改造，最终成为罗伯特·帕丁森与马特·里维斯在2022年带来的《新蝙蝠侠》。因此，我们或许永远无法知道原本那部电影会是什么样子，但Manganiello回忆，自己当时满怀期待。

paragraphs.en: "It sounded good to me," Manganiello writes. "I told Ben how great I thought his films were, especially The Town, and how I was really looking forward to seeing his Best Picture version of a Batman movie."
paragraphs.cn: 「我听着觉得很不错，」Manganiello写道，「我告诉本，我觉得他的电影很棒，尤其是《城中大盗》，我也非常期待看到他拍出一部最佳影片水准的《蝙蝠侠》电影。」

paragraphs.en: When the Deathstroke actor told Affleck that writing, directing, producing, and starring in a big-budget DC superhero movie sounded like a lot to handle, the Batman actor reportedly replied, "Yeah, I know…But don’t worry, you’re in good hands. You’re in good hands, man."
paragraphs.cn: 这位丧钟演员对阿弗莱克说，要在一部大制作DC超级英雄电影中同时担任编剧、导演、制片人和主演，听起来实在要承担太多工作。据称，这位蝙蝠侠演员回答道：「是啊，我知道……不过别担心，有我在，你放心。放心交给我吧，伙计。」

paragraphs.en: Although so much about what a standalone Batman movie under Affleck's wing would have looked like remains shrouded in mystery, we've learned quite a bit about the process in recent weeks. Affleck said just days ago that reshoots for Justice League marked the lowest point in his career . Manganiello also spoke more about what it felt like to be cast as Deathstroke and then elaborated on his experience post-cancellation .
paragraphs.cn: 阿弗莱克操刀的蝙蝠侠独立电影究竟会是什么样子，至今仍有许多谜团，但最近几周，我们已经了解了不少筹备过程中的事情。就在几天前，阿弗莱克表示，《正义联盟》的补拍是他职业生涯的最低谷。Manganiello也进一步谈到了获选饰演丧钟时的感受，并详细讲述了项目取消后的经历。

paragraphs.en: We'll probably never get a DCEU Batman movie, but there is still plenty more of the Caped Crusader coming to live-action. DC Studios bosses James Gunn and Peter Safran are still working to put together The Brave and the Bold and The Batman Part 2 , for example. Set photos from the latter suggest Pattinson's Batsuit may have some new Arkham Asylum-inspired armor .
paragraphs.cn: 我们可能永远也看不到一部DCEU版《蝙蝠侠》电影了，但这位披风义警仍有不少真人作品在筹备中。例如，DC影业负责人詹姆斯·古恩和彼得·萨夫兰仍在推进《英勇无畏》和《新蝙蝠侠2》。后者的片场照显示，帕丁森的蝙蝠战衣可能会增添一些借鉴《蝙蝠侠：阿卡姆疯人院》的新护甲。
